claims.text: Alila Ubud sits on a hillside above the Ayung River, surrounded by jungle canopy.

findings.quote: Perched above the sacred Ayung River, Alila Ubud offers a secluded hillside retreat surrounded by jungle canopy and calming stillness.
findings.note: Covers the hillside setting, the position above the Ayung River and the jungle canopy.

claims.text: The resort blends contemporary design with traditional Balinese architecture.

findings.quote: Blending contemporary design with traditional Balinese architecture

claims.text: The rooms and villas overlook the Ayung River Valley and are designed to resemble a Balinese village.

findings.quote: Overlooking the rolling hills of the Ayung River Valley, Alila Ubud’s 56 rooms and 18 villas offer a secluded retreat, designed to resemble a Balinese village.
findings.note: Covers both the valley view and the village-style design.

claims.text: Lower-floor rooms have individual garden terraces, and high-floor rooms have spacious balconies with jungle views.

findings.quote: Revel in individual garden terraces in all of the lower-floor rooms, and spacious balconies with jungle views in the high-floor rooms.

claims.text: Deluxe rooms have a private garden terrace and back courtyard, an outdoor bathtub and shower, and garden and valley views.

findings.quote: Step inside this 700-square-foot room, featuring two twin beds, private garden terrace and back courtyard, an outdoor bathtub and shower, and sweeping garden and valley views.
Enjoy this 700-square-foot room, which comes with one king bed, private garden terrace and back courtyard, an outdoor bathtub and shower, and sweeping garden and valley views.

claims.text: The Pool Villa has a private pool and an open-air tub among lotus, and includes in-villa check-in and check-out.

findings.quote: Enjoy in a secluded 120-sqm villa with a private pool, surrounded by gardens and trees. Relax in an open-air tub among lotus, or on terrace daybeds. Includes swift in-villa check-in/out.
findings.note: Covers the private pool, the open-air tub among lotus and in-villa check-in/out.

claims.text: The Two Bedroom Villa is the resort's largest, with a private pool, outdoor tubs and a separate dining area.

the Two Bedroom Villa is the resort’s largest, with a private pool, outdoor tubs, and a separate dining area.

claims.text: Spa Alila combines contemporary wellness products and services with ancient Asian healing techniques.

findings.quote: At Spa Alila, we combine contemporary wellness products and services with ancient Asian healing techniques and age-old beauty recipes.

claims.text: A weekly wellness program includes sunrise yoga, Qi Gong and Tai Chi.

findings.quote: During our weekly wellness ritual, begin with sunrise yoga, where body and spirit align with the first light of day, or discover the flowing grace of Qi Gong and Tai Chi

claims.text: Guests can craft their own silver piece side by side with local Balinese artisans, or work alongside a farmer in the rice fields.

findings.quote: forge bonds—literally and figuratively—with local artisans while you work side-by-side to craft your own piece of wearable art.
Experience the joy, rhythm, and beauty of bringing rice to the table as you work with a farmer to cultivate this most precious nutrient.
as long as you are comfortable enough to walk through the rice fields

findings.note: Covers the pavilion, the roof and the valley setting.
